notes: Access: Claude-in-Chrome tab throughout, no WAF/challenge on page loads. robots.txt explicitly names anthropic-ai and Claude-Web with 'Allow: /products/ /collections/ /pages/ /blogs/' -- explicit permission, not a block. Tree source: (1) the site's own Furniture mega-menu, read directly from the homepage DOM (custom-menu-level-2/3 accordion), which has exactly 5 room groups under Furniture -- Living, Bedroom, Dining, Outdoor, Study -- with no Kids/Office/Nursery group; (2) a full enumeration of /collections.json (300 collections total across the whole store, paginated) filtered against a 40+ term furniture keyword list (sofa/chair/table/bed/desk/cabinet/wardrobe/stool/bench/dresser/shelv/bookcase/seating/dining/nightstand/armchair/recliner/ottoman/sectional/chaise/daybed/tv unit/console/sideboard/headboard/armoire/vanity/pouf/crib/cot/etc.), which returned only 94 furniture-keyword-matching handles and confirmed no wardrobe/armoire/crib/cabinet/kids/office/nursery collection exists anywhere on the store outside the 27 handles already reachable from the mega-menu. Qty method: exhaustive pagination of /collections/<handle>/products.json (limit=250, deduped by numeric product id) for every leaf -- this is the exact method the prior Home-Decor pass on this same store proved reliable (raw collections.json products_count/cached counts are inflated on this store). Cross-validated once here: Sofas' exhaustive count (52) matched the rendered category-page header verbatim ('Showing 1-30 of 52 total'), so the method was trusted for the remaining leaves per the 'corroborate once' rule. Excluded 'Floor Mirrors' (/collections/floor-mirror) from the Bedroom group -- mirrors are always out of scope regardless of nav placement. Excluded ~63 other /collections.json handles that furniture-keyword-matched but are NOT in the site's own mega-menu nav: these are all auto-generated material/colour/shape/size/feature filter-tag collections layered on the 27 real categories -- e.g. wooden-*, sheesham-wood-*, teak-wood-*, marble-*, metal-*, glass-top-*, upholstered-*, cane-* (material tags); blue-sofa, green-sofa, white-sofas (colour tags); round-*, rectangle-*/rectangular-*, oval-dining-table, l-shape-sofa, sectional-sofa, corner-sofa, sofa-1/2/3-seater, 3-seater-wooden-sofa, 4/6-seater-dining-tables, king-size-beds, queen-size-beds, *-with-hydraulic-storage, *-without-storage (shape/size tags); coffee-table-with-storage, dining-table-with-bench, bedside-table-with-drawer, bed-base, day-bed, platform-bed, foot-stool, storage-cabinet, display-units, teapoy-tables, ribbed, latest-wooden-dining-table-set (feature/style tags); plus umbrella roll-ups chairs(66)/dining(92)/bedroom(79)/arm-chairs/bedroom-chairs/living-room-chairs. This matches the exact pattern the prior Home-Decor pass on this store already documented and excluded (mixed-material/style tag collections redundant with the real nav categories) and matches brief section 3 (price/colour/material filter pages are never categories). 'Book Shelves' (/collections/book-shelf) is cross-listed in both the Living and Study nav groups on the site; listed once here under Living Room to avoid a duplicate row. table-decor/table-lamps/table-styling/study-table-lamps/wooden-table-lamp keyword-matched on 'table' but are Lighting/Decor, not furniture -- excluded (matches prior Home-Decor pass scope). Access note: after ~61 sequential same-origin products.json fetches (27 confirmed masters + 34 of ~63 tag-collection overlap checks) the storefront JSON API returned HTTP 429 on further requests; per the hard-block rule all further requests to the target were stopped immediately. This did not leave any core result incomplete -- all 27 mega-menu-sourced leaf categories were already fetched successfully and cross-validated before the block occurred; the interrupted work was only a supplementary product-id-overlap check on the tag/filter collections already excluded on nav-absence + naming-pattern grounds.
